map.本工具按总体公式 σ²=Σ(x−x̄)²/n 计算（除以 n）。若做推断统计需样: This tool uses the population formula σ²=Σ(x−x̄)²/n (dividing by n). Inferential statistics need the sample variance (dividing by n−1), which you can switch to in the geological data statistics tool; the two differ very little when n is large.
map.构造对比：比较背斜两翼的倾角/厚度统计特征，判断对称性或倒转程度: Structural comparison: compare the dip and thickness statistics of the two limbs of an anticline to judge symmetry or the degree of overturning
map.标准差反映数据围绕均值的离散程度。对产状数据而言，σ 偏大意味着褶皱两翼倾角差异: The standard deviation reflects how much the data disperses around the mean. For attitude data, a large σ means the dips of the two limbs of the fold differ markedly or the observation error is large, so you should check with a cross-section whether it is structural asymmetry or a measurement bias.
map.标准差大说明什么？: What Does a Large Standard Deviation Mean?
map.褶皱（背斜/向斜/轴面）分析 使用指南: Fold (Anticline / Syncline / Axial Plane) Analysis Guide
map.褶皱（背斜/向斜/轴面）分析工具。输入地层产状与几何参数，判断褶皱类型（背斜/向: Fold (anticline / syncline / axial plane) analysis tool. Enter the strata attitude and geometric parameters to identify the fold type (anticline / syncline) and estimate the axial plane attitude, for structural geology teaching and field interpretation reference.
map.：例：录入 7 个观测点的岩层倾角（°）12, 25, 18, 30, 22,: : Example: entering the rock dip angles (°) 12, 25, 18, 30, 22, 15, 28 for 7 observation points gives n=7, Σ=150, mean x̄=21.43°, median=22°, standard deviation σ=6.23°, range=18° (max 30°, min 12°). The attitude data has moderate dispersion, with one limb steeper than the other.
map.：算法：输入逗号/空格/换行分隔的数值序列，自动计算数据量 n、总和 Σ、均值: : Algorithm: enter a numeric series separated by commas, spaces, or newlines and it automatically computes the count n, the sum Σ, the mean x̄=Σ/n, the median (the middle value for an odd count, the mean of the two middle values for an even one), the variance σ²=Σ(x−x̄)²/n, the standard deviation σ=√σ², the minimum, the maximum, and the range. All computation happens in the local browser and no data is uploaded (at least 2 valid numbers are required to output statistics).
